what: PRE-FREEZE POSITIVE CONTROLS for fuzz_v5e.py, run against the design panel's scratch prototype (not the implementation that will be scored) through a scratch shim, each with one attribution or identity rule broken by a one-line source edit. A fuzzer that cannot see a broken rule proves nothing by finding no disagreements.

mutations.C1_no_cut: the hook's f_back walk no longer stops at asyncio.events.Handle._run
mutations.C2_credit_any_open: a hit is credited to any open opening of the tracer, whether or not its anchor is on the frame's chain
mutations.C3_no_mint: the tracer observes the function's ORIGINAL code object instead of a minted one

first_version.note: fuzzer v1 generated event loops only at the top of a program, so no section anchor ever sat below a dispatch frame: C1 went UNDETECTED. The 'loop' node (an event loop run inside a sync segment) was added because this control caught the blindness.

generator_invariant: no 'loop' node is generated on a thread whose event loop is running: checked on 5000 seeds
